name: Hero 4 (woodsman)
description: a lean, broad-shouldered man about 35, a woodsman and ranger: short dark-brown hair and a neatly trimmed short beard, a weathered face; a dark-brown wool hooded half-cloak (ONE simple layer, no fur) over both shoulders, reaching the elbows at the sides and in a point to the waist at the back, the hood DOWN, fastened at the throat with a large iron ring clasp; an olive-green padded jerkin to mid-thigh with two bold leather straps crossing the chest, over a cream shirt whose sleeves show at the upper arms; long dark-brown leather bracers; a wide brown belt with a square iron buckle, a leather pouch at his right hip and a sheathed hunting knife at his left hip; tan trousers; knee-high dark-brown boots with turned-down cuffs. Both hands EMPTY: NO bow, NO quiver, NO arrows, NO weapon held or carried.

references.note: round 1, style from hero-3 + hero-2: woodsman ~35, short dark hair and beard, brown hooded half-cloak with an iron ring clasp (one layer, to the hips), olive jerkin with crossed straps, tan trousers, tall boots. APPROVED (copied to reference/reference.png).

round 1: young scout ~25, short black hair, no cloak: riveted leather vest over a rust-red tunic, green scarf (came out as a thick cowl), green trousers, strapped boots. No cloth to animate; the vest's leather texture is a bit mottled. APPROVED as a separate character: hero-5 (the scout).

round 1: veteran ~45, grey-streaked hair in a short tail, stubble, long forest-green cloak to mid-calf (one layer, two disc clasps), leather jerkin over a grey shirt, brown trousers, tall boots. The long cloak is the most work to keep steady (needs --cloth, as hero-2's cape). Not taken forward.
